div.head: II Cn 62
div.ab: Gif hwa hamsocne gewyrce, gebete þæt mid V pundan þam cingce on Engla lage (⁊ on Cent æt hamsocne V þam cingce ⁊ þreo þam arcebisceope), ⁊ Dena lage, swa hit ær stod.
Hamsocne. Gyf hwa hamsocne gewyrce, gebete ðæt mid V pundum ðam kynincge on Engla lage, [⁊ on Dena] lage, swa hit ær stod.
Gif hwa hamsocne gewyrce, gebete þæt mid fif pundum þam cyninge on Engla lage, ⁊ on Dena lage, swa hit ær stod.
Si quis hámsocnam faciat, V libras emendet regi in Anglorum laga, et in Dena laga sicut lex stetit antea.
Si quis inuasionem domus aut curię fecerit, quod Angli (dicunt) hamsocne uocant, quinque libras regi emendet.
[62] Si quis domi inuasionem fecerit, emendet hoc V libris erga regem in lege Anglorum, in lege autem Danorum sicut prius institutum fuit.
Hamsocne. Gyf hwa hamsocne gewyrce, gebete ðæt mid V pundum ðam kynincge on Engla lage, [⁊ on Dena] lage swa hit ær stod.
Gif hwa hamsocne gewyrce, gebete þæt mid V pundan þam cingce on Engla lage; and on Cent æt hamsocne, V þam cingce and þreo þam arcebisceope; and on Dena lage, swa hit ær stod.

(Heimsuchung. B) Wenn einer [widerrechtliche] Heimsuchung verübt, büsse er das mit 5 Pfund dem König in Engländer-Recht (und in Kent [gehören] von Heimsuchung[-Strafe] 5 [Pfund] dem König und 3 dem Erzbischof G), und im Dänen-Recht so, wie es bisher galt.

(Housebreaking. B) If anyone commits [unlawful] attack on a house, let him atone for it with 5 pounds to the king under English law (and in Kent, from the house-attack [penalty], 5 [pounds belong] to the king and 3 to the archbishop, G), and under Danish law as it has stood hitherto.

Attacks upon men's houses. If a man makes forcible entry into another man's house, he shall pay £5 to the king as compensation for so doing in districts under English law, and in the Danelaw the amount fixed by existing regulations.
If anyone commits hamsocn, he is to compensate for it with five pounds to the king in the area under English law, and in the Danelaw as it stood before.

If someone is guilty of home invasion, he is to pay five pounds to the king in areas under English law; and in Kent for home invasion, five pounds to the king and three to the archbishop; and in the Danelaw, as it was previously decreed.

div.note: The words in brackets about Kent are only in G (a Kentish addition; Liebermann compares I Cn 3.2). G lacks ‘on’ before ‘Dena lage’; Liebermann supplies it from the other MSS. Only the italic formatting of K was corrected here.; BR: added from Gesetze I p. 351, October 2026 (MS Cons); AP: corrected against Whitelock p. 471, October 2026 (was “If anyone commits hamsocn, he is to compensate for it with five pounds to the king in the area under English law, and in the Danelaw as it stood before.”, now “If anyone commits hamsocn, he is to compensate for it with five pounds to the king in the area under English law, and in the Danelaw as it stood before. (expanded letters in italics: hamsocn)”)
